video.composer.label: Your comment
video.composer.placeholder: What were you thinking here? A question, something unclear, anything.
video.composer.placeholderWholeEpisode: What do you think of the episode as a whole?
video.comment.olderTime: A time in an earlier version of the video
video.comments.heading: Comments
video.comments.lead: Ask questions or suggest changes. Say so in the chat, and the agent will read them and reply.
video.rating.heading: How was this episode?
video.watchDepth.heading: How did you watch it?
video.share.heading: Send feedback to the team
video.share.lead: Your comments help the team improve the teaching and the tools. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
video.share.title: Send this feedback to the Heptabase Explainer Studio team?
video.share.consent: It helps improve how the videos teach and how the tools work. The team uses it only inside Heptabase and never to train AI models.
video.share.also: the comments and ratings you shared before, with any later edits; the agent's notes on how it handled each comment and the tool limits it recorded; frames of the video a few seconds around each comment; the script and timeline of each delivery; the series plan; the Explainer Studio version and operating system; the time, tokens and estimated narration cost of making the series plan and this episode (numbers only).
video.share.never: your source files and the full video or audio.
video.share.failedBody: The feedback could not reach the team. Nothing was marked as sent, so you can try again now or later.
video.missing.title: The video file is missing
video.missing.body: It is no longer at {path}. Put it back there, or ask your agent to deliver the episode again.
video.redelivered.title: A new version of this episode was delivered.
video.cost.heading: Cost of making
video.cost.group.episode: This episode, up to its first delivery
video.cost.noteUsage: Usage only: the agent's tokens as its transcripts recorded them, and narration as spending.jsonl recorded it. For the agent's usage in dollars, add a price table at {path}.

video.cost.unpriced: No price in the price table for {models}: left out of the dollars.
